title: apex-3v1s LNR TERRA: native tool search on an admitted Responses route. PASS = the tool_search declaration is tools[0], the bridge is neither declared nor called, a client-executed tool_search_call is answered by a tool_search_output naming archive__package_manifest, and that call and its result close the round trip. Harness premise 0-hit -> BLOCKED; model premise 0-hit -> VACUOUS; any other pin 0-hit -> FAIL.

steps.prompt: Use native tool search to discover the archive server's read-only package_manifest tool, which reads the isolated probe-build pager Cargo manifest. Invoke the discovered function directly using its returned name and schema. Do not call search_tool, use_tool, shell, read-file, pty, weave, or any other lookup tool. After the successful tool result, reply HTS-3V1S-LNR-TERRA-RESULT followed by the complete JSON object from that result and nothing else.
Without calling any tool, repeat the complete JSON object from the previous archive package_manifest tool result. Prefix your answer with HTS-3V1S-LNR-TERRA-DONE and include nothing else.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): bounds the filtered set so the last:0 selections below name the FIRST request of this row.

CONTROL (harness premise): the hosted tool_search declaration is hoisted to tools[0] of the first admitted-route request. Hoist: client.rs:1598-1600,1613-1621; declaration bytes responses.rs:1041-1069 (preserve_order, :1033-1034).

wire.grep: Searches over deferred tool metadata with BM25
wire.label: The declaration carries the campaign description (responses.rs:1015-1029). any:true = fail-closed on an empty filtered set (run.py:3791-3802).

An admitted Responses route carries NO bridge declaration (sampler_turn.rs:456-470). Declaration shape taken from the in-tree body fixture h1-accept-cw1-req007-EV-1.json:565-567, so a historical call item cannot satisfy it. all:true requires absent:true and fails closed on an empty set (run.py:3751-3758).
MODEL PREMISE: the provider minted a client-executed native search call that the harness replayed into the next request (item type tool_search.rs:135; the answer arm turn.rs:3634-3729).
The declaration and the answer are the CLIENT-execution form (execution enum ToolSearchExecution::Client, responses.rs:912-928; answer key order tool_search.rs:604-640 with CLIENT_EXECUTION at :177).
The harness answered the search: the paired output item (tool_search.rs:146).

The harness-authored answer itself names the discovered tool: the client answer's tools[] entries are {"type": "function", "name", "description", "parameters"} (turn.rs:3702-3716) inside the item built by ToolSearchItem::client_answer (tool_search.rs:599-612). The window is TEMPERED with a negative lookahead on the next item's type tag so the needle cannot leak past the answer into the model's FOLLOWING function_call: the untethered [\s\S]{0,4000}? window was measured to still hit when the answer named a different tool, i.e. the loose form passes a rig whose discovery answer is defective (section 7, ARM-LNR-3b).

PAIRING: the output item's call_id is the id of an earlier call in the same captured request. Output key order (type, call_id, status, execution, tools) is source-verified at tool_search.rs:604-640; the replayed call item's key order is UNVERIFIED, so the pattern stays agnostic about it and binds only on the id.

MODEL PREMISE (second leg): the model then called the discovered tool DIRECTLY. The name+arguments key pair is the discriminating form: the harness answer's tool definitions carry "name" followed by "description"/"parameters" (turn.rs:3702-3716), and the MCP announcement renders '- archive (1 tool)' (search_tool/mod.rs:190-196), so neither can satisfy this needle. The pair itself is pinned by fn_result_pair. Key adjacency is UNVERIFIED per section 4.4 and is byte-checked in T4.1.
MODEL PREMISE (third leg): the fixture result rode the next request. The nonce is in no prompt (section 4.5).

PAIRING of the second leg: the direct call's call_id is the call_id of the function_call_output whose output leads with the fixture nonce, so the discovered call CLOSED on the real fixture payload (fields per sampler_turn_tests.rs:7719-7727; the 200-char output window holds because section 8.1 makes the nonce the payload's first key). Key adjacency UNVERIFIED per section 4.4.
The LNR/LHR discriminator: this family must never reach the tool through the bridge (the prompt forbids it).
HTTP 200 on the final request of the row; status_in makes the pin assertive (run.py:3894, the list test at :3934-3935).
